Sunset aboard SQ23, world's longest flight from JFK to SIN. We left New York on the evening of the 16th, here we are about 11 hours into the flight over Azerbaijan just south of Baku, the Caspian Sea is hidden below the clouds. After spending a few brief hours in the sunlight we head back into the night for the rest of the flight. We will touch down in Singapore just over 18 hours after departure on the 18th, having spent the entirety of 17th in the air.

This Boisavia B-601L “Mercurey Luxe,” designed by engineer and pilot Lucien Tielès, is one of a batch of 12 examples fitted with various Lycoming engines (150 hp O-320, 170 hp O-340, or 180 hp O-360), depending on the customer’s choice. Registered OO-KLO in November 1988, it was saved from a hangar engulfed in flames at Namur in January 1993, before being restored between 1995 and 1998.
